name: Mishi Zonghezheng
source:
Even you find it strange...

You, an ordinary person with nothing special about you, were actually hired by the "company"?

Your boss is gentle and polite, your colleagues get along well, everything seems perfect. But you always have a vague feeling—something's not quite right.

Your only job is treating a bizarre illness you've never heard of before—"Disorientation Syndrome."

In this seemingly normal office building, you can only truly interact with three people: your boss, your colleagues, and a mysterious special employee.

This is a psychological horror visual novel. Every choice you make will affect the plot and character relationships, gradually revealing the hidden truth behind the company.

Experience the chilling everyday horror, explore branching storylines and multiple endings. Will you ultimately choose to escape, or... become completely lost and remain in this company forever?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4437770/_Disorientation_Syndrome/]Steam[/url]]
